rules.check: Find small crawls with the END-OF-JOB summary 'successfully visited: N urls' (or admin/front METRIC_EVENT CrawlSummary totalUrlsCount), NOT the progress counter 'successfully visited N pages so far' — the counter is never printed for 0-visit crawls (~60% of small crawls were invisible to the validated query).
rules.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && ($d.message ~ 'successfully visited: ' || $d.message ~ 'filtered out: ' || $d.message ~ 'failed to scrape: ' || $d.message ~ 'not including url in result url set' || $d.message ~ 'http status code is: ' || $d.message ~ 'failed due to' || $d.message ~ 'allowed domains' || $d.message ~ 'final url after redirections' || $d.message ~ 'typing text in element' || $d.message ~ 'clicking element') | extract $d.message into $d.s using regexp(e=/^(?<k>successfully visited|failed to scrape|filtered out): (?<n>\d+) urls/) | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job aggregate max(if($d.s.k == 'successfully visited', $d.s.n:number, null)) as visited, max(if($d.s.k == 'failed to scrape', $d.s.n:number, null)) as failed, max(if($d.s.k == 'filtered out', $d.s.n:number, null)) as filtered, count_if($d.message ~ 'not included in whitelist') as wl, count_if($d.message ~ 'language is not included') as lang, count_if($d.message ~ 'already visited') as dup, count_if($d.message ~ 'content type') as ctype, count_if($d.message ~ 'max number of successful') as cap, count_if($d.message ~ 'is: 200') as s200, count_if($d.message ~ 'http status code is: ' && !($d.message ~ 'is: 200')) as snon200, count_if($d.message ~ 'typing text' || $d.message ~ 'clicking element') as interactions, any_value(if($d.message ~ 'failed due to', substr($d.message:string, 0, 100), null)) as faildue, any_value(if($d.message ~ 'allowed domains', $d.message:string, null)) as allowed, any_value(if($d.message ~ 'final url after', $d.message:string, null)) as seed_final | filter visited <= 1
rules.outcome_if_true: candidate list with all discriminating columns in one row per job
rules.evidence: 2026-11-01..02: 59 jobs visited=0 + 35 jobs visited=1; CrawlSummary DONE/totalUrlsCount=0 >= 60

rules.check: Seed document status non-200 (403/400/503/429/202) and nothing else
rules.query: (columns snon200>0, s200==0 from step 0) or: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && $d.message ~ 'http status code is: ' && !($d.message ~ 'is: 200') | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job, $d.message aggregate count() as n, any_value($d.context.url) as url
rules.outcome_if_true: → A1/A2/A5 (block at request 1; 503/202 lean A2 challenge). Not C.
rules.evidence: 12 jobs (sainsburys, natwest, verizon, sky helpforum, xfinityprepaid x2, comcastpreview x2: 403; philadelphia.comcast 503; skyawardsfyc 400)

rules.check: 'failed due to DNS_ERROR_COULD_NOT_FIND_URL' / OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT / INTERNAL_ERROR on the seed
rules.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && $d.message ~ 'failed due to' | extract $d.message into $d.fr using regexp(e=/failed due to (?<reason>[A-Z_0-9]+)/) | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job, $d.fr.reason aggregate count() as n
rules.outcome_if_true: DNS → C4 (seed unreachable / internal host); OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT → D1/A1 tarpit

rules.check: 'failed due to PAGE_INTERACTION_PLUGIN_ERROR', or interaction lines ran and seed final URL still on a login/IdP path (/login, /authenticate, /auth, /guest)
rules.query: columns faildue, interactions, seed_final from step 0
rules.outcome_if_true: → B2/B3 login failure (or B5 session wall for /guest with failed>0). Not C6.
rules.evidence: 5 PAGE_INTERACTION jobs (zalando, spectrum x3, accredo); cigna x2 (/web/public/guest, failed 25/41); cportal.jazz (interaction ran, still #/login, visited 1)

rules.check: wl>0 and the rejected URL == seed final URL, and host(final URL) is NOT covered by the 'allowed domains: {…}' line
rules.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && ($d.message ~ 'allowed domains' || $d.message ~ 'final url not included in whitelist' || $d.message ~ 'final url after redirections') | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job aggregate any_value(if($d.message ~ 'allowed domains', $d.message:string, null)) as allowed, any_value(if($d.message ~ 'whitelist', $d.context.url:string, null)) as rejected, any_value(if($d.message ~ 'final url after', $d.message:string, null)) as seed_final, count_if($d.message ~ 'whitelist') as wl | filter wl > 0
rules.outcome_if_true: → C2 (seed redirects outside whitelist). If the rejected host is an IdP/login (login.microsoftonline.com, id.*, /auth) → B4/B5 instead.
rules.evidence: ~33 jobs on 11-01..02 (14 <state>.comcast.com → corporate.comcast.com, effectv → comcastadvertising, wingslax → nll.com, sky x3...); 2 IdP cases (marq, bluemovie, bellmedia)

rules.check: wl>0 but host(rejected) IS in 'allowed domains' (so the include regex / path whitelist rejected it); also 'language is not included in whitelist' on the seed
rules.query: same as step 4; compare host vs allowed list
rules.outcome_if_true: → C1 (include regex / locale filter). Exception: final URL like /unavailable, /geo → A7.
rules.evidence: 5 jobs (satsuite.collegeboard x2, healthcare4mi /en, capitalone.com/credit-cards, williamsinn) + 9020c59c stg.xfinity.com (allowed but rejected); wowtv.de/unavailable = A7
rules.confidence: medium (regex itself not logged; subdomain semantics of allowed list unverified)

rules.check: 'max number of successful visits was reached' with visited = 1
rules.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && $d.message ~ 'max number of successful visits was reached' | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job aggregate count() as n
rules.outcome_if_true: → page cap configured to 1 (C7/C3-family config: 'pages limit'), not discovery failure

rules.check: Only rejects are 'content type application/pdf' and 'sanitized url was already visited' on #/fragment URLs
rules.outcome_if_true: → C5 (fragment routes collapsed — untick 'ignore URL fragments') / C6 SPA
rules.evidence: ga-nmsn, mdnewhire, ky-newhire, co newhire, dealernavigator, discover portal, capitalone/coders (7 jobs)

rules.check: Seed 200, final URL == seed (no host change), filtered 0, failed 0, no interaction, no non-200
rules.query: columns from step 0: visited=1, s200=1, filtered=0, wl=0, faildue=null
rules.outcome_if_true: → C6 or A3 or A2-with-200 — NOT separable from logs. Browser '[browser] [error] … status of 403/405' on a sub-resource leans A2/A3; seed path /login leans login wall.
rules.evidence: ~10 jobs (design.comcast, business.comcast, internet.xfinity, xfinity planbuilder, elleactive.hearst, boxtops qa, charterverify, dinersclub, ap.collegeboard)

rules.check: Huge crawl: progress counter 'crawling page. visited N pages so far' > 10k and 'final url is included in' (blacklist) rejects > 90% of scraped URLs; CrawlSummary FAILED
rules.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && $d.message ~ 'not including url in result url set' | extract $d.message into $d.rx using regexp(e=/reason: (?<reason>[a-zA-Z ]{0,30})/) | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job, $d.rx.reason aggregate count() as n | filter n > 10000
rules.outcome_if_true: → C3 scope too broad (exclude applied after fetch, job times out)
rules.evidence: 1 job: Salesforce 'Developer - All Except Docs' 130k scraped / 129,745 blacklist rejects, 10.8 h, FAILED totalUrlsCount 0

rules.check: Part 2: distinct tenants per hour with FAILED / dispatch-failure lines > baseline (3)
rules.query: source logs | filter ($l.subsystemname == 'admin-server' || $l.subsystemname == 'front-server') && ($d.message:string.matches(/state changed from \w+ to FAILED/) || $d.message ~ 'changed state to: FAILED' || $d.message ~ 'Failed running create crawl request' || $d.message ~ 'passed its timeout, marking it as FAILED' || $d.message ~ 'HikariPool') | extract $d.message into $d.mdc using regexp(e=/tenancyName=(?<tenant>[^\]]+)\]/) | groupby roundTime($m.timestamp, 1h) as hour aggregate count() as n, distinct_count(firstNonNull($d.context.tenant_name:string, $d.mdc.tenant:string)) as tenants | orderby tenants desc
rules.outcome_if_true: tenants >= ~5 in one hour, or worker volume collapse (backtest June) → E1
rules.evidence: week 10-27..11-02 max 3 tenants/h (no outage); June outage visible only as volume drop

rules.check: One property: 'Failing URL set <id> due to job timeout/failure' + 'Failed running create crawl request' (RuntimeException), or scrape-server HikariPool exhaustion at the run time; CrawlSummary status FAILED
rules.query: source logs | filter ($l.subsystemname == 'admin-server' || $l.subsystemname == 'front-server') && ($d.message ~ 'Failing URL set' || $d.message ~ 'Failed running create crawl request') | groupby $d.context.tenant_name, $d.context.property_id aggregate count() as n, distinct_count(formatTimestamp($m.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d')) as days
rules.outcome_if_true: → E3 (chain stop for that property); repeats on consecutive runs = stuck job
rules.evidence: ~20 properties in 14 days, 1–2 days each; 1:1 pairing confirmed; #3228 Salesforce (Hikari) in backtest

rules.check: UI failure: RestExceptionHandler 5xx with $d.context.request_uri ('uri=/api/...') joined by operation_id to FunctionLogger 'invocation of function (X) failed (<Exception>)'; or FunctionLogger 'took N millis' at Warning (N>10 000)
rules.query: source logs | filter $l.subsystemname == 'front-server' && $d.logger_name == 'c.e.c.l.f.FunctionLogger' && ($d.message ~ 'failed (' || $d.message ~ 'took') | extract $d.message into $d.fx using regexp(e=/\((?<fn>[A-Za-z]+\.[A-Za-z]+)\) (?<what>took|failed)/) | extract $d.message into $d.fm using regexp(e=/(?<ms>[0-9]+) millis/) | groupby $d.fx.fn:string as fn, $d.fx.what:string as what, $m.severity as sev, $d.error.type aggregate count() as n, distinct_count($d.context.tenant_name) as tenants, max($d.fm.ms:number) as maxms | orderby maxms desc
rules.outcome_if_true: took >10–60 s or NotFoundException(scan deleted) → E5; NullPointerException/IllegalArgumentException repeatedly on one uri → F3 product bug (E5 symptom)
rules.evidence: 11-02: NPE x35 /api/property-overview (bell media, PagesEnricherStrategy.kt:42) = F3; ScanController.list 50 s, checkReportExists 67 s = E5; Scan not found x2 = E5
rules.confidence: high (F3 by exception class) / medium (E5 timeout: 502 not logged)

still_ambiguous.why: Seed 200, final URL = seed, filtered 0, no error: identical log inventory (LinkExtractorPlugin logs no link count; no title/DOM size). ~10 jobs in 2 days.
Seed 403 at request 1; no challenge marker (cf-ray/title) logged. 503/202 only a weak lean to A2.

Same reason text 'final url not included in whitelist' for domain whitelist and include regex; separable only by comparing host with the 'allowed domains' line; include regex not logged in clear (config dump holds credentials).
'Failed running create crawl request' wraps 'Job failed due to timeout/failure' with no underlying cause; only cross-tenant count per hour separates them.
front-server does not log the 502/timeout returned to the browser; slow calls are only 'took N millis' Warnings.

Progress counter for 0-visit crawls / CrawlSummary reason
logging_gaps.suggested_fields: CrawlSummary: visited, failed, filtered, top_filter_reason, seed_final_url, failure_reason

logging_gaps.suggested_fields: previous job id, last state, k8s job status, age
